question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 9 years 5 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Certain sum of money

Time (T) = 9 years 5 months = 9 + 5/12 years = 9.4167 years

Amount (A) = 2 × Principal (2P)

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Amount (A) = P + SI
